definition: Massive and imposing in size or scale; resembling or suggestive of the work of the mythical Cyclops, often used to describe architecture or construction of huge, crude stone blocks fitted together without mortar.
translation: 巨大的；龐大的；（建築風格）由巨型石塊堆砌的
example: The ancient fortress was built with cyclopean walls made of enormous stones fitted together without any binding material.
